label: Salish-Shidhe
_note: Matches Shadowrun's Salish-Shidhe Council. Stub for now, and for a different reason than sioux.json/ute.json: what turned up for Coast Salish (Lushootseed) names describes specific names bestowed through formal ceremony and inherited within families across generations — not a generic pool of common given names the way English or Spanish ones are. Generating random Lushootseed-style names would mean using real families' inherited names as flavor text, which seemed worse than leaving this empty. Shadowrun's own in-fiction names (e.g. the 'Native American Nations Vol. 1' sourcebook) are a better source if available.
